name: ANGLE Graphics Driver
author: Kyro
description:
Force selected games to use the ANGLE graphics backend through Android global driver settings.
This plugin: • Scans gamelist.txt
• Detects installed games automatically
• Applies ANGLE driver only to valid packages
• Skips missing packages safely
• Supports multi-game driver override
Useful for improving compatibility, reducing graphical glitches, and stabilizing problematic GPU drivers.
⚠ Performance improvement is not guaranteed. Effect depends on device GPU and Android version.
